name: Pawmot
description: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

moves.name: Revival Blessing
moves.description: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.

moves.name: Scratch
moves.description: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Nuzzle
moves.description: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Spark
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Arm Thrust
moves.description: The user attacks the target with open-palmed arm thrusts. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Slam
moves.description: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

moves.name: Entrainment
moves.description: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Double Shock
moves.description: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with a fiery punch. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with an icy punch. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Metronome
moves.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.description: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target's HP in half.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Charm
moves.description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

moves.name: Metal Claw
moves.description: The target is raked with steel claws. This may also boost the user's Attack stat.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before using the move.

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.description: The user slaps down the target's held item, making it unusable for that battle. This move does more damage if the target has a held item.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by cutting off its movement.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Thunder Fang
moves.description: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Low Sweep
moves.description: The user makes a swift attack on the target's legs, which lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.description: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.description: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Eerie Impulse
moves.description: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.description: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.description: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.

moves.name: Body Press
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

moves.name: Coaching
moves.description: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Supercell Slam
moves.description: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

moves.name: Upper Hand
moves.description: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.
